name: The Who

whyMatters.en: Maximum volume, smashed guitars, rock opera: youth rage and concept ambition share one stage—the bridge from Invasion to Hard Rock.
whyMatters.zh: 最大音量、砸琴、摇滚歌剧：青年暴怒与概念野心同台——从 Invasion 通向 Hard Rock 的桥。

note.zh: 口吃式怒火：一代人的宣战
合成器风与摇滚怒吼的合流

interviewQuotes.text: Rock is art and the stuff of life.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Pete Townshend

lyricQuotes: I hope I die before I get old

shortBio.en: The loudest, most violent British Invasion branch.
shortBio.zh: 最大声、最暴烈的 British Invasion 支线。

body.en:
The Who treat the stage like a demolition site and a theater at once. Townshend's windmill, Moon's chaos, Entwistle's lead-bass, Daltrey's howl—Invasion energy with Hard Rock's coming weight.

They prove youth fury can carry concept without losing the smash.
body.zh:
The Who 把舞台同时当拆迁现场与剧场。Townshend 的风车、Moon 的混沌、Entwistle 的主音贝斯、Daltrey 的嚎——Invasion 能量，Hard Rock 将至的重量。

他们证明青年怒火能扛概念，而不丢掉砸碎的那一下。

body.en:
My Generation stutters like a fist. Tommy and later rock-opera ambition show the same band can draft architecture.

Decisive because they refuse the false choice: either destroy or compose. They do both under one name.
body.zh:
My Generation 口吃得像一记拳头。Tommy 与后来的摇滚歌剧野心证明同一支乐队也会画建筑图。

决定性在于拒绝假二选一：要么毁灭，要么作曲。他们在同一个名字下两样都干。

title.en: My Generation: a stuttered declaration of war

body.en:
1965. Daltrey trips over the words on purpose; the bass solo barges in like an argument. Hope I die before I get old is less lyric than detonator.

British youth finds a voice that will not tidy itself for the drawing room.
body.zh:
1965 年。Daltrey 故意在词上绊倒；贝斯 solo 像抬杠闯进来。Hope I die before I get old 与其说是歌词，不如说是雷管。

英国青年找到一种不肯为客厅整理仪容的嗓音。

title.en: Won't Get Fooled Again: synth wind, same howl
title.zh: Won't Get Fooled Again：合成器风，同一声嚎

body.en:
The organ scream, the power chord landslide, Daltrey's final yell—seventies rock learns spectacle without quitting politics-of-the-gut.

Invasion violence grows into Hard Rock theater. The bridge is audible.
body.zh:
风琴嘶叫、强力和弦滑坡、Daltrey 最后那一声——七十年代摇滚学会奇观，却不放弃肠子里的政治。

Invasion 的暴力长成 Hard Rock 剧场。桥是听得见的。

title.en: From Mod clubs to arena thunder
title.zh: 从 Mod 俱乐部到体育馆雷声

body.en:
Punk later steals the attitude and shortens the fuse. Arena rock steals the volume and the gesture. Prog-adjacent ambition steals the opera nerve.

The Who sit at the junction where British Invasion stops being cute and starts being dangerous architecture.
body.zh:
后来 Punk 偷走态度、缩短引信。体育馆摇滚偷走音量与手势。偏 Prog 的野心偷走歌剧神经。

The Who 站在路口：British Invasion 不再可爱，开始变成危险的建筑。

body.en:
Townshend talks theory; Moon lives entropy; the quotes swing between manifesto and mischief.

Pin both. The band's intelligence and its violence are the same engine with different gears.
body.zh:
Townshend 谈理论；Moon 活在熵里；金句在宣言与恶作剧之间摆。

两种都钉上。这支乐队的智力与暴力，是同一台引擎的不同档位。

note.en: Stutter, smash, and volume as youth politics.
note.zh: 口吃、砸琴与音量即青年政治。

note.en: Power-chord violence + rock-opera ambition in one band DNA.
note.zh: 强力和弦暴力与摇滚歌剧野心同体。
